items.title: AI Patch Runner
items.content: AI Patch Runner is an admin-only WordPress developer tool for reviewing, previewing, applying and rolling back structured JSON patch packages for installed plugins. Production patching is blocked by default and requires both trusted server-side configuration and an explicit admin setting before writes are allowed.
items.excerpt: Admin-only WordPress patch workflow for structured JSON review, preview, controlled apply and rollback with production writes disabled by default.

items.title: ACF CSV Manager
items.content: ACF CSV Manager focuses on the spreadsheet-first side of my WordPress content tooling: exporting ACF and page text for structured review, then importing validated edits back through a controlled admin workflow. CSV/XLSX handling, upload validation, import preparation and progress feedback make larger content updates reviewable before WordPress writes are processed.
items.excerpt: Spreadsheet-first WordPress content workflow for exporting ACF/page text, reviewing edits and importing validated CSV/XLSX changes safely.

items.title: Modern Image Manager
items.content: A WordPress media-management plugin for reviewing image metadata, importing and exporting updates, scanning image usage and creating controlled media ZIP exports from one admin interface. The workflow combines bulk operations with capability checks, validation and safer file-handling boundaries.
items.excerpt: Media admin workflow that combines metadata review, usage scanning, CSV-based updates and controlled ZIP creation behind validation and capability checks.

items.title: ACF Page Text Manager
items.content: Centralized editing of text-oriented WordPress fields is the purpose of ACF Page Text Manager. The custom admin tool brings ACF fields, page and post titles, excerpts, Yoast and Rank Math metadata, and image text into one workflow, with inline editing and validated CSV/XLSX import and export for larger reviews.
items.excerpt: Central WordPress text-management tool for ACF, Yoast/Rank Math metadata, image text, titles and excerpts with validated CSV/XLSX workflows.

items.title: Spring architecten
items.content: For Spring Architecten, my contribution focused on a portfolio-led presentation where architectural projects remain the visual priority. Large project photography, spacious layouts and direct project browsing are supported by clear mission and team content on desktop, tablet and mobile.
items.excerpt: Architecture portfolio work focused on project-led layouts, large imagery, clear browsing and responsive presentation for Spring Architecten.

items.title: SEO Image Assistant
items.content: Shutterstock image handling moves into the WordPress editorial workflow with SEO Image Assistant. The plugin combines OAuth-based access, keyword and page-based search, mapped ACF fields, queued suggestions, licensed-asset recovery and capability-gated REST endpoints inside the admin.
items.excerpt: Editorial stock-image workflow that keeps page context, licensing state and ACF image mapping inside WordPress before the asset reaches the media workflow.

items.title: Dcaschoonmaak
items.content: Reliable housekeeping and cleaning personnel are the immediate business focus of the DCA Schoonmaak hotel-staffing site. Role-based staffing content, a clear working process and trust signals lead hotel decision-makers toward a personnel request.
items.excerpt: Hotel-staffing site built around housekeeping roles, a working process, trust signals and personnel requests.

items.title: Babylonsafety
items.content: Urgent fire-safety and on-site safety services lead Babylon Safety's WordPress presentation. Emergency availability sits beside service and regional pages, trust signals, vacancies and practical safety content, with quote actions kept visible for business customers.
items.excerpt: Babylon Safety brings urgent services, regional coverage, trust content and vacancies into a business-facing site with visible quote actions.

items.title: Translate
items.content: Multilingual content management comes together in Translate, a custom WordPress plugin built around a controlled, review-first workflow. It scans WordPress content across pages, public post types, Elementor, ACF and WooCommerce, then combines visual editing, CSV/XLIFF import and export, SEO metadata handling and optional AI assistance before publication.
items.excerpt: Review-first translation workflow that inventories WordPress strings, keeps visual context available and supports larger CSV/XLIFF language reviews before publication.

items.title: Seo Shutterstock
items.content: SEO Shutterstock stays narrowly focused on the stock-acquisition step of page production: finding a licensed Shutterstock image and assigning it to the intended ACF field. OAuth access, page and keyword search, controlled downloads and guarded REST endpoints keep that external-media handoff inside WordPress.
items.excerpt: Page-production tool focused on licensed Shutterstock discovery, safe download and ACF field assignment.

items.title: Dcadienstverlening
items.content: A WordPress service website for DCA Dienstverlening that organizes a broad cleaning and specialist-cleaning offer into clear service routes. The project combines SEO-oriented service structure, client proof and reviews with visible quote and contact actions for both business and residential visitors.
items.excerpt: Specialist cleaning choices lead into proof and quotation without collapsing business and residential needs into one path.

items.title: ACF image auto filler
items.content: Safe bulk image assignment is the core task of ACF Image Auto Filler, a WordPress automation plugin for supported ACF Image fields and featured images. A React-powered admin workflow combines preview mapping, manual overrides, batch processing, overwrite controls, rollback and audit logging before large content changes are committed.
items.excerpt: Preview-first WordPress image assignment with manual overrides, rollback safeguards and audit logging for supported ACF and featured-image fields.

items.title: Wehear4u
items.content: Readable treatment information and a calm visual hierarchy shape WeHear4U's care website, with contact actions kept close to the relevant care content. Responsive layouts preserve that hierarchy and the next-step actions at each screen size.
items.excerpt: Care-focused WordPress site where readable treatment information, calm layouts and visible next steps support the route from orientation to contact.

items.title: Fidelyaa
items.content: A WordPress business website for a consultancy focused on strategic advice and tender guidance. My work gave the specialist service offer a clearer hierarchy, with strategic advice and tender guidance leading into relevant information and contact options on different screen sizes.
items.excerpt: Consultancy website that gives strategic advice and tender guidance a clear hierarchy, with supporting detail and contact options kept close to each service.

items.title: Socool for Woocommerce
items.content: Eligible WooCommerce orders move to the SooCool API through a custom transport integration that keeps fulfillment data connected to the store. It automates order submission, pickup and delivery tasks, shipping labels, tracking and status updates while keeping WooCommerce order data HPOS-compatible and the workflow controlled when API calls fail or retry.
items.excerpt: Transport automation that keeps WooCommerce orders, pickup and delivery events, labels and tracking tied to the correct order through retries and webhook safeguards.

items.title: Content sync manager
items.content: Content Sync Manager provides an administrator-only WordPress workflow for exporting, reviewing and importing content across posts, pages, products and supported custom post types without opening every item individually. It combines dynamic ACF detection, summaries, Yoast meta descriptions, media metadata, backups and an exact preview-before-import check.
items.excerpt: Administrator review workflow for round-tripping WordPress content, ACF data, SEO descriptions and media metadata with backups and an exact checked-preview gate.

items.title: Egaline Calculator
items.content: Material quantity calculation sits directly on WooCommerce product pages in WooCommerce Egaline Calculator. Thickness, surface area and product settings determine the required material quantity and order-ready selection, with live quantity and price updates, simple and variable products, discounts, cart metadata and product-specific configuration.
items.excerpt: WooCommerce material calculator with linked area, thickness and bag calculations, live pricing, product settings and cart/order integration.

items.title: Exam Registration Manager
items.content: A WordPress workflow for managing exam registrations, participant details, dates and status updates from one structured admin experience. The project turns a process that can easily become fragmented across forms and spreadsheets into a clearer, maintainable registration flow inside WordPress.
items.excerpt: Exam-registration admin flow that keeps participant details, exam dates and status updates in one maintainable WordPress process.

items.title: Services Overview Manager
items.content: A WordPress plugin for managing a structured service catalogue through a dedicated custom post type, categories, pricing fields and summaries. A frontend shortcode adds category and search filtering, while administrators can move service data through controlled CSV import and export workflows.
items.excerpt: Service-catalogue tooling built around a dedicated WordPress content model, with frontend discovery and controlled CSV administration.

items.title: Sparxentertainmentagency
items.content: Sparx Entertainment Agency focused on presenting a large entertainment offering through clear event, service and artist routes. Bands, DJs, live artists, special acts and supporting entertainment are grouped around event choices, testimonials and enquiry points, linking each occasion to fitting entertainment.
items.excerpt: Entertainment agency site where event-led navigation connects occasions to artists, supporting services, testimonials and enquiry.

settings.title: WordPress · WooCommerce · Elementor · ACF · Performance · Remote NL/EU

settings.editor: I build and improve WordPress, WooCommerce and Elementor websites that stay fast, manageable and ready to grow. Open to remote WordPress roles across the Netherlands and EU.
Browse websites, WooCommerce webshops and custom WordPress plugins.
Responsive WordPress websites with clear structure, strong usability and maintainable content, built with Elementor, ACF and custom front-end work.
WooCommerce webshops focused on clear product discovery, responsive shopping flows and straightforward routes from browsing to checkout.
Custom WordPress plugins and admin tools for specific workflows, integrations, performance improvements and automation.

settings.title: WordPress development for fast, editable and maintainable websites

settings.editor: Structured websites and webshops with reusable sections, clean editing flows and less unnecessary plugin dependency.
Editable page structures that clients can manage without breaking layout, content or design consistency.
Core Web Vitals, accessible structure, lighter assets and technical SEO improvements that support speed, usability and search visibility.
Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions and Playwright for safer changes, repeatable checks and reliable delivery.

settings.title: 10+ years of front-end, UX and WordPress experience

settings.editor: My background combines front-end development, UX thinking, SEO and WordPress. I use Git/GitHub, automated checks and structured QA to keep work reliable and maintainable after launch.

Bergo was where I learned how a webshop works in practice. Working with developers and designers, I kept Magento pages clear, tidy and easy to use. That job gave me a solid start in building and improving websites.

Blueprint Sound Academy gave me more room to work on the look and feel of a website. Small changes to layouts, navigation and page details made the site feel more consistent. From there, I started paying more attention to how people move through a website.

At Kamernet, the user came first. Simple sketches and test screens helped us see where people got stuck before we built the final version. Their feedback showed me how a few small changes could make the whole journey easier.

Easytheorie was where WordPress became part of my everyday work. Clearer pages, better content and work on Google search helped people find the right information faster. WordPress, design and content started to come together for me there.

Wube was where I started building complete WordPress websites for clients. Each project had different wishes, so I learned to turn them into a site that looked good and stayed easy to manage. Before launch, I checked phones, different browsers and speed so the site was ready to use.

Today at Webactueel, I work on WordPress and WooCommerce sites from start to finish. Some days I build pages, other days I fix a plugin, speed up a site or solve a client problem. Over time, I have made my own checks and tools so I can spot issues earlier and keep the work reliable.

settings.title: Remote-ready WordPress delivery: from idea to tested release

settings.editor: Every project starts with the goal, users and content. I then move through clear structure, WordPress development, Git/GitHub, automated QA and performance/accessibility checks so work can be reviewed and delivered reliably from anywhere.
I clarify what the website needs to achieve before deciding how it should be structured and built.
I organize pages, content and user journeys so visitors can find what they need without friction.
I create clean WordPress setups with reusable code, Git-based version control and maintainable editing flows.
I test releases with Playwright, Core Web Vitals and accessibility/WCAG checks, then refine details until the site is stable and ready to grow.
